title: Migration Receipt Schema
description: 12-field mandatory schema for TEMPORARY_THIN_ADAPTER migration receipts in agentic_core governance. Validates that app-specific bindings have a concrete migration path with CI-enforced expiration.

binding_file.description: Exact path to the binding file in agentic_core/ that this receipt validates

classification.description: Governance classification of the binding file

owner.description: Owner responsible for migration (github username or email)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when receipt was created

migration_target_date.description: Target date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which migration must complete. CI will fail if expired.

expiry_enforced_by_ci.description: Must be true. CI gates will reject receipt if false or missing.

migration_path.description: Concrete migration path describing how to move to generic engine + app profile

blocking_migration_reason.description: Specific reason migration is currently blocked (e.g., dependency not ready)

adapter_only_justification.description: Proof that binding is thin adapter only: no business logic, no policy branching, no orchestration, no durable writes, only translation/binding behavior

test_coverage.description: List of test file paths proving adapter-only behavior

items.description: Path to test file relative to repo root

approver.description: Person who approved this receipt (github username or email)

plan_id.description: Optional: Plan ID that authorized this receipt (e.g., 'agentic-core-governance-remediation-c4e8a2')

original_binding.description: Optional: Reference to original binding if this is a migration receipt

rules: binding_file must match exactly the file being validated
classification must be in allowed enum
created_at must be valid ISO 8601 timestamp
migration_target_date must be YYYY-MM-DD format and not expired
migration_path must be at least 20 characters
adapter_only_justification must be at least 100 characters
test_coverage must be non-empty list, each path must exist
